content:
The much-anticipated return of "Ted Lasso" is almost here, with Season 4 set to premiere on Apple TV+ next week (watch here). Apple just released the official trailer.

"Ted Lasso" Season 4 trailer highlights beloved returning characters and new additions to the cast

Next week marks the biggest premiere of the year for Apple TV+: "Ted Lasso" Season 4, airing on August 5.

This beloved comedy starring Jason Sudeikis is returning more than three years after its previous season aired. The new season shifts focus from the AFC Richmond men's team to the newly formed "Lady Greyhounds."

For a full introduction to the new cast members and to see which returning favorites will be back, click here.

The new trailer released today doesn't reveal much about the plot, instead featuring music by Mumford & Sons alongside touching clips of beloved characters to evoke nostalgia for Lasso.

Here's the official synopsis for Season 4, along with the new trailer:

If you love "Ted Lasso," "Trying" is another heartwarming comedy worth watching on Apple TV+. The show is currently in its fifth season and holds a 97% fresh rating on Rotten Tomatoes.

What do you think of the new "Ted Lasso" trailer? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, or you can bundle it with other services through Apple One for a discounted price.
